name: Rebellimon
main_effect:
[When Digivolving] You may trash 1 card in your hand to have this Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.) until the end of your opponent's next turn.
[All Turns] This Digimon is also treated as black.
